system.description:
You attack with your weapon with such ferocity, it is if a wrecking ball erupts forward. All creatures in a 30-foot lone, 5-foot-wide line must make a Dexterity Saving Throw. On Failure they take your [Weapons damage] +2d8 and are Pushed to the end of the jutsu’s range, into a space that can hold them. On a success they only take half damage and no additional effects.

Chain 1: Creatures with ranks of Weakened must make their saving throw at disadvantage.

Chain 2: On a successful hit, another allied creature can spend their reaction to cast a Taijutsu with the Finisher keyword that has a casting time of 1 Action, targeting the same creature. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
